statusLine.command: seg() { printf '\033[1;48;5;%s;38;5;%sm %s \033[0m' "$1" "$2" "$3"; }; input=$(cat); out=""; m=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); e=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); if [ -n "$m" ]; then s="Model: $m"; [ -n "$e" ] && s="$s ($e)"; out="$out$(seg 27 231 "$s")"; fi; c=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); if [ -n "$c" ]; then s=$(printf 'Context %.0f%%' "$c"); out="$out$(seg 201 16 "$s")"; fi; d=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.project_dir // .cwd // empty'); if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/.mcp.json" ]; then en=$(jq -r '(.enabledMcpjsonServers // []) | join(" ")' "$d/.claude/settings.json" 2>/dev/null); mcp=$(jq -r --arg en "$en" '.mcpServers // {} | keys | map(select($en == "" or (. as $k | ($en | split(" ") | index($k)) != null))) | join(", ")' "$d/.mcp.json" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$mcp" ]; then out="$out$(seg 36 16 "MCP $mcp")"; fi; fi; [ -n "$out" ] && printf '%s' "$out"
